name: edit_file
description: Find-and-replace edits on a text file inside my home folder (e.g. site/photobooth/index.html), or copy a home file into a path. Use before publish_page with from_file, so small page fixes don't need full republishing. Also can report size/grep lines. NEW: push_to_repo {repo:"owner/name", path:"dir/file.html", message} uploads the (edited) file to GitHub (creates or updates), so site files can be mirrored to repos without pasting.

copy_to.description: optional: after edits, also write result to this home-relative path

grep.description: optional: return lines containing this text (with line numbers)

push_to_repo.description: optional: upload the file to GitHub
